# Steam workshop
[textlink="Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"] · [textlink="Equipment recipes" link="CMUGuideIndustryRecipes"]
[bold]Water → pump → liquid pipe → boiler → gas pipe → machine.[/bold]
## Place and connect - Right-click portable machinery → [bold]Pick up[/bold]. Free both hands, then click a reachable clear floor tile to place it. Operate it after placing it. - Place a water pump on suitable water. Supply the boiler through its water port; load fuel in the boiler window. - [bold]Liquid pipes:[/bold] [textlink="choose a shape and rotate" link="CMUGuideIndustryPipes"], then wrench each piece down. Touching open ends connect automatically. Use a screwdriver on a pipe, then its touching machine; explicitly choose INPUT or OUTPUT. Right-click the machine → Pipe connections to inspect or disconnect a link. - [bold]Steam pipes:[/bold] use the gas-pipe network. Place and wrench compatible pipe ends together. Liquid pipes do not carry the boiler's atmospheric steam.
## Open machine → fill slots → collect Click a placed machine with an empty hand to open its window. Hold an ingredient and click its input slot to insert it; use an empty hand on an occupied slot to retrieve it. Matching stacks can be topped up. Machines process automatically when their requirements are met.
- [bold]Drill:[/bold] place over a deposit or supported rock floor. Supply steam or electricity and empty the output slots. It extracts material; use a handheld tool to open a shaft. - [bold]Press:[/bold] insert the correct reusable mold and ingots. The solid-fuel version takes fuel; the steam version takes steam. - [bold]Grinder:[/bold] load materials and supply power/steam. Collect powder and byproducts from its output slots. - [bold]Steam smelter:[/bold] load ore/powder and the required mold. Use its regulator and route liquids/byproducts through the indicated ports. - [bold]Condenser:[/bold] supply the material fluid and coolant to their ports, plus any solid material the recipe needs in its slot. The brass model needs steady coolant; the electric model also needs power. - [bold]Steam generator:[/bold] connect steam, then take electricity from its HV connection.
[bold]Stopped?[/bold] Check placement → water/fuel/steam → inputs and mold → output room. Examine the machine for its status.
